_: demo/trailer.md, as data. Interpreted by scripts/assemble-demo.ts --edl.
_source: demo/capture/raw.webm is a 2 MiB, 1920x1080, duration=N/A stub — not the tape. The real capture is the file below: 3840x2160 / 698.2s, matching marks.json exactly (videoSize 3840x2160, totalMs 698741).
_geometry: No crop is authored here. Every crop names a target MEASURED during capture; zoom is either a fill ratio or a ratio of frame width, never a rectangle.
_deviation_actI_punch: trailer.md asks Act I to punch the `failed` cell in the REPORTED column. marks.json measured no such cell on the blockedRow shot — only `row` and `caption`. Rather than author coordinates, this punches the measured `caption` (the RETRY BLOCKED / 'One transaction, not two.' end of the row), which is the same beat's payload and is real geometry. To get the spec's exact framing, re-capture with a `reported` target on blockedRow.
_deviation_letterbox: trailer.md specifies 2.39:1 throughout. Clips render through the film's shared renderPiece (16:9); only cards carry the letterbox hairlines. Letterboxing clips would mean changing a primitive the film depends on, so it is left alone deliberately.
_CUT_explorer: trailer.md Act II ends on 4s of a public explorer showing the confirmed transaction. That shot is NOT in the capture: every frame across the whole 407s `basescan` mark (121.4s-528.6s) is an empty Blockscout shell — nav, search box, Log in, ad card, no transaction. marks.json's own evidence.explorerBody corroborates it (chrome text only, no tx fields). The transaction is real and confirmed — a Base Sepolia receipt returns status=success at block 45386595 — so this is a capture failure, not a false claim. But holding 4s on a blank page while implying independent verification is exactly what the honesty constraints forbid, so the shot is cut until it can be re-captured. Its 5s went to afterMatch (+2.5), scroll (+1.5) and slam (+1.0).
_KNOWN_matchcut: The REPORTED and CHAIN TRUTH cells are adjacent columns ~188px apart, so any crop tight enough to isolate one from the other (zoom ~10x) is illegible. Both words are therefore visible in both halves of the match cut, which softens the 'one word different' reveal trailer.md is built around. Fixing it properly needs the two verdicts framed apart at capture time, not a different crop here.
_vo: The trailer's 10 VO lines do not exist — demo/vo/ is absent and .env carries no TTS key. Every duration below is picture-derived, so narration can be added later without moving a single cut.
